requirement: A chat turn keeps what it took: the close carries its steps, tool calls and failed calls, read off its own events, and tracy-web keeps them by the newest close

oracle.ref: PR #1415 (feat); fix evidence: Plan tasks/todo-do-dung-that.md U1: a turn's steps and refused calls lived only in dsh's session log (scripts/agent-turn-cost.mjs read them from the container), so no usage view could say how hard a turn was
oracle.invariant: S1: {steps: 2, calls: 4, failedCalls: 2}; another turn's events are not counted; no step logged reads null. S2: the first two closes carry work; the third sends none. S3: a work without a turn, missing a count, negative, fractional, over 10000 or with more failed than calls is refused before any job; the newest close's work is kept, an older one heard late writes nothing over it, a close without work keeps it; a turn closed by an older dsh reads null.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
